audit.whatIsWrong: The chart is the generic Skill/Singed/Singed/Skill/Skill/Singed/Singed template. It scores Levels 4-5 and Level 6 as even while whys[3] says 'once that cooldown is spent, Mega Adhesive roots the gap-close attempt and your poison clock starts' and whys[4] says Insanity Potion makes you too tanky for his burst. It then scores two items as Singed while whys[6] says to 'play the Rylai's side-lane loop rather than hunting the straight 1v1'.
audit.why: Emerald+ 54.02% over 2660 games — a large sample and a clear Singed lane once Mega Adhesive exists, because the goo grounds his only mobility. Two items is where a Sylas with stolen ultimates catches back up in fights, which is exactly what the prose says. The packet chart reads Skill, Singed, Singed, Singed, Singed, Singed, Skill.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5, Level 6 and two items moved as one group, both layers, with each phases[N].why rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] is labelled 'Lvl 2' and claims Fling and Mega Adhesive are both online there. And no cooldown appears anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Two abilities cannot be ranked at level 2 — Fling at 2, Mega Adhesive at 3. The numbers that matter: Abscond/Abduct is 13/12/11/10/9s, Chain Lash 10/9/8/7/6s, Kingslayer 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s, Hijack 80/55/30s. Hijack at 80s versus Insanity Potion's flat 100s is the one that changes behaviour — he gets your stolen ultimate back faster than you get your real one, so the page's advice to 'force him to burn Insanity-Potion-copy on a bad window' is worth less than it sounds.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].when and .text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, phases[3].why and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abscond/Abduct is called a stun in five places — breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d ('His dash + stun (recast pull)'), report[5].t, wants.foe[0] ('Chain E into you to stun'), whys[2] ('his E stun is dangerous') and the late paragraph ('never let him stun you'). Sylas's E has no stun. wants.foe[0] also attributes Petricite Burst to his Q. And the two interactions that actually decide the lane are both absent: Mega Adhesive grounds his dash, and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds cuts Kingslayer.
audit.why: Riot's Abscond/Abduct text: 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.' A dash and a self-pull, no crowd control on you at all — a Singed player told to fear a stun will hold Flash for something that does not exist. Petricite Burst is the passive, not the Q; the Q is Chain Lash. Meanwhile Mega Adhesive is 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it' and grounding shuts off dashes, so goo under Sylas removes his only mobility tool outright — the page describes it as a root, which is weaker and comes later. And Kingslayer is his heal ('lunges at an enemy... healing himself against enemy champions'), while Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds for 100s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, dontsFull[0].d, wants.you[0], wants.foe[0], whys[2], whys[4] and spikes[0].text.

audit.why: Rylai's first into Riftmaker or Liandry's is right against a Sylas who has to walk into the cloud once grounded, and Mercury's Treads is correct against Chain Lash's slow. Nothing to change; the anti-heal question is answered by Insanity Potion rather than by an item, which is now written into dontsFull[0].d.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Abscond / Abduct's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your window. Mega Adhesive grounds Abscond, so he has to walk — and it is 13s at rank 1 if he spends it, which is a full proxy lap.

edits.before: Ult-ghost-proxy is a macro weapon — you win by farming where he is not. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sylas's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds for 100s, halving Kingslayer — but Hijack is 80s, so he gets your ult back first.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Sylas carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Your pattern is at full power but he still steals ultimates in fights. Carry threat 8.5/10 — play the loop, not the 1v1.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Abscond/Abduct: 13s at rank 1, a dash and a self-pull — no stun. Mega Adhesive grounds it outright. - Chain Lash: 10s. - Kingslayer: 12s heal-dash. - Hijack: 80s. - Insanity Potion: 100s of Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A dash and a self-pull, and no stun at all — 13s at rank 1. Mega Adhesive grounds it.

edits.before: That is Sylas's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Kingslayer heals him right back — pop Insanity Potion and poison cuts it.

edits.before: Track Sylas's Abscond / Abduct: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. When it is down — Fling into goo, poison out.
edits.after: Abscond/Abduct is a dash and a self-pull, never a stun — and Mega Adhesive grounds it, so goo on his feet means he has to walk.

edits.before: Fling + Mega Adhesive roots Sylas before his E chain-dash is online — punish any overextension hard here.
edits.after: Fling at 2 and Mega Adhesive at 3 — the goo grounds Abscond outright, so he cannot dash out of your cloud.

edits.before: Bait Sylas's E chain-dash into Mega Adhesive so he is rooted and Flung into your Poison Trail
edits.after: Drop Mega Adhesive on him — grounded he cannot Abscond at all — then Fling him into the cloud

edits.before: Chain E into you to stun and proc his Q Petricite Burst empowered auto for burst damage
edits.after: Abduct onto you, then spend Petricite Burst charges on empowered autos while Chain Lash slows

edits.before: Full kit running and Sylas still has to walk through your Poison Trail to reach you; his E stun is dangerous but you can Fling him out of his own dash arc.
edits.after: Full kit running and Sylas still has to cross your Poison Trail; Abduct pulls but never stuns, and Mega Adhesive grounds the dash before it starts.

edits.before: Insanity Potion makes you too tanky and fast for his chain-dash burst to kill reliably; avoid popping it while he has his own copy ready.
edits.after: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, gutting Kingslayer — but Hijack is 80s at rank 1, so never pop it into a ready steal.

notes: Two 'stun' references survive because neither fits the band: content late ('never let him stun you in the middle of the enemy team') and content mid, which tracks 'his E chain-dash cooldown' without calling it a stun but still frames E as the threat rather than as the thing your goo deletes. Both are worth a second pass. Also not written for lack of room: Hijack lets Sylas cast a stolen Insanity Potion, and a Singed ult in Sylas's hands applies Grievous Wounds to your side too, which matters if your team has a healer — I could not verify from the kit data whether the stolen version keeps the Grievous Wounds rider, so I left the claim out entirely.
